subject: MANAGER DISPOSITION: publication verifier READY_FOR_PRIMARY; atomic CAS remains blocked
body: Manager independently reviewed the completed live-write/idempotency lane at current HEAD 1cf46d7505ee74a8f4434be6d77a890ddce57ac1. The canonical research ZIP SHA-256 e3cc7362cb530ac4b924df16e5bd4102023b10059e16109e3656c6f5b28d7601 was materialized from Library, all internal checksums verified, raw exact-path/collision evidence inspected, and the 5-test verifier suite independently rerun 5/5 PASS. Disposition split: READY_FOR_PRIMARY for the fail-closed publication verification contract (actual path must equal requested path; readback hash must equal source; reconcile immutable message id; same-id/same-hash aliases consumed once + surfaced; same-id/different-hash quarantined; snapshot counts semantic ids separately from storage aliases). NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE/BLOCKED for using Library pathname creation as PrimarySingletonLease or atomic CAS: same requested path with overwrite=false auto-renames and succeeds, so pathname exclusivity is not a lock. Dedicated lease/fencing lane remains authoritative for that gap. No production write authority claimed.
